newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Cosipa still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cosipa still a hold.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it was maintaining its hold rating on Brazilian private steelmaker Cosipa.
-- It said in a report it believes that Cosipa is slowly but surely improving in terms of cost efficiency as well as product quality.

-- "For 1997 and 1998, we expect that Cosipa's gross profit will experience a dramatic improvement. However, we doubt that the company's extra cash generation will solve its debt repayment situation, thus forcing it to raise new funds by other means," it said.
-- Cosipa posted a net loss of $150.9 million in 1996, slightly above Salomon's estimates of a $142 million net loss.
-- Its gross profit decreased 52 percent to $51.2 million from $107.2 million, the report said.
-- Cosipa preferred shares were up 5.97 percent at 0.71 reais in late morning trade on the Sao Paulo bourse.
